result.justification: The paper clearly states the objective of evaluating small molecules against RSV replication and provides detailed methodology for experimental procedures, making it reproducible and clearly linked to the objective.

objective_evidence.quote: The Mini-NLuc-sfGFP system was employed to evaluate small molecules for antiviral activity against RSV.

method_evidence.quote: Statistical comparisons were made using Student’s two-tailed t-test and two-way ANOVA, with significance set at a p-value < 0.05.
